nodes.label: Motion Search ROI Scan
nodes.rationale: Pixel-change scan over recordings inside a user-drawn polygon. Knobs are all speed/completeness trade-offs: parallel mode scans multiple recording segments at once but uses more decode resources, frameSkip processes every Nth frame (set to camera FPS for one frame per second) and is faster but can miss short motion events, maxResults stops early. Segments are skipped when inactive or when they do not overlap the ROI heatmap, with a full-range fallback.
